import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorModulesLocal

/-!
# Native local generators of divisor modules

A global divisor section attaining its valuation bound at a point gives an
isomorphism from the structure sheaf on a neighborhood of that point. This
identifies the actual section map used in the generation step of the divisor
Grassmannian construction, with the local trivialization of `O(D)`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

private lemma restrict_map_app {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    {M N : X.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N) (V : Y.Opens) :
    ((Modules.restrictFunctor f).map φ).app V = φ.app (f ''ᵁ V) := rfl

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverModule overModule divisorSectionsModule

variable (K : Type u) [Field K] {X : Scheme.{u}}
  [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]
  [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]

omit [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] in
include K in
/-- Coefficient equality at a point extends to an affine neighborhood. -/
theorem exists_affineOpen_coeffAt_eq (D E : X.CurveDivisor) (x : X)
    (hx : ∀ hx : x ≠ genericPoint X, coeffAt hx D = coeffAt hx E) :
    ∃ W : X.Opens, x ∈ W ∧ IsAffineOpen W ∧
      ∀ (z : X) (hz : z ≠ genericPoint X), z ∈ W → coeffAt hz D = coeffAt hz E := by
  classical
  let Bad : Set X := {z | ∃ hz : z ≠ genericPoint X, coeffAt hz D ≠ coeffAt hz E}
  have hfin : Bad.Finite := by
    apply Set.Finite.subset (((toFinsupp (D - E)).support.finite_toSet).image Subtype.val)
    rintro z ⟨hz, hne⟩
    refine ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr ?_, rfl⟩
    change coeffAt hz (D - E) ≠ 0
    rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_sub]
    exact sub_ne_zero.mpr hne
  have hclosed : IsClosed Bad := by
    rw [← Set.biUnion_of_singleton Bad]
    exact hfin.isClosed_biUnion (fun z hz =>
      isClosed_singleton_of_ne_genericPoint (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hz.choose)
  let U : X.Opens := ⟨Badᶜ, hclosed.isOpen_compl⟩
  have hxU : x ∈ U := by
    rintro ⟨hx', hne⟩
    exact hne (hx hx')
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hxW, hWU⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset hxU
  exact ⟨W, hxW, hW, fun z hz hzW =>
    not_not.mp (fun hne => hWU hzW ⟨hz, hne⟩)⟩

/-- A native map from the structure sheaf multiplies rational values by its unit section. -/
theorem divisorVal_homFromUnit {D : X.CurveDivisor}
    (φ : Modules.Hom (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) (divisorModules K D))
    {U : X.Opens} (hU : (U : Set X).Nonempty) (r : Γ(X, U)) :
    divisorVal K (φ.app U r) =
      (X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hU)).hom r *
        divisorVal K (φ.app ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))) := by
  have hlin : φ.app U r = r • φ.app U (1 : Γ(X, U)) := by
    have hs : (r • (1 : Γ(X, U)) : Γ(SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf, U)) = r := by
      change (r : Γ(X, U)) * (1 : Γ(X, U)) = r
      exact mul_one r
    exact (congrArg (fun t : Γ(SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf, U) => φ.app U t)
      hs.symm).trans (φ.app_smul r (1 : Γ(X, U)))
  have hres : φ.app U (1 : Γ(X, U)) =
      divisorSectionsRes K D (le_top : U ≤ ⊤) (φ.app ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))) := by
    have h := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply φ.val
      (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))
    change φ.app U (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))) =
      divisorSectionsRes K D (le_top : U ≤ ⊤) (φ.app ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))) at h
    simpa only [map_one] using h
  rw [hlin, hres]
  change divisorVal K (QcohOn.qsmul (F := X.divisorSheaf K D) le_rfl r _) = _
  rw [divisorVal_qsmul K (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hU)]
  congr 1
  exact divisorSectionsRes_coe K le_top hU _

/-- The reciprocal generating function cancels the rational value of the
native section map on each nonempty open. -/
theorem divisorVal_mul_homFromUnit {D : X.CurveDivisor}
    (φ : Modules.Hom (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) (divisorModules K D))
    (q : X.functionFieldˣ)
    (hq : (q : X.functionField) * divisorVal K (φ.app ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))) = 1)
    {U : X.Opens} (hU : (U : Set X).Nonempty) (r : Γ(X, U)) :
    divisorVal K ((mulEquivDivisorModules K q D).hom.app U (φ.app U r)) =
      (X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hU)).hom r := by
  rw [divisorVal_mulEquivDivisorModules K q D hU, divisorVal_homFromUnit K φ hU]
  rw [mul_left_comm, hq, mul_one]

/-- The principalization comparison agrees sectionwise with the zero-divisor
map, with the section-ring argument kept on the ambient curve. -/
theorem restrictDivisorModulesApp_principalization_homFromUnit {D : X.CurveDivisor}
    (φ : Modules.Hom (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) (divisorModules K D))
    (q : X.functionFieldˣ)
    (hq : (q : X.functionField) * divisorVal K (φ.app ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))) = 1)
    (W : X.Opens)
    (hW : ∀ (z : X) (hz : z ≠ genericPoint X), z ∈ W →
      coeffAt hz (D - divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q) = coeffAt hz 0)
    (V : W.toScheme.Opens) (r : Γ(X, W.ι ''ᵁ V)) :
    restrictDivisorModulesAppOfCoeffAtEqOn K
      (D - divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q) 0 W hW V
        ((mulEquivDivisorModules K q D).hom.app (W.ι ''ᵁ V)
          (φ.app (W.ι ''ᵁ V) r)) =
      moduleToDivisorZeroPresheafApp K (W.ι ''ᵁ V) r := by
  by_cases hV : ((W.ι ''ᵁ V : X.Opens) : Set X).Nonempty
  · apply divisorSection_ext K
    trans divisorVal K ((mulEquivDivisorModules K q D).hom.app (W.ι ''ᵁ V)
      (φ.app (W.ι ''ᵁ V) r))
    · exact restrictDivisorModulesAppOfCoeffAtEqOn_coe K
        (D - divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q) 0 W hW V _
    · exact (divisorVal_mul_homFromUnit K φ q hq hV r).trans
        (moduleToDivisorZeroPresheafApp_coe_of_nonempty K hV r).symm
  · haveI := divisorSections_subsingleton_of_empty K (D := 0) hV
    exact Subsingleton.elim (α := divisorSections K 0 (W.ι ''ᵁ V)) _ _

private lemma restrict_coeff_iso_hom (D E : X.CurveDivisor) (W : X.Opens)
    (hW : ∀ (z : X) (hz : z ≠ genericPoint X), z ∈ W → coeffAt hz D = coeffAt hz E) :
    (restrictDivisorModulesIsoOfCoeffAtEqOn K D E W hW).hom =
      restrictDivisorModulesHomOfCoeffAtEqOn K D E W hW := rfl

private lemma restrict_coeff_hom_app (D E : X.CurveDivisor) (W : X.Opens)
    (hW : ∀ (z : X) (hz : z ≠ genericPoint X), z ∈ W → coeffAt hz D = coeffAt hz E)
    (V : W.toScheme.Opens) (s : divisorSections K D (W.ι ''ᵁ V)) :
    (restrictDivisorModulesHomOfCoeffAtEqOn K D E W hW).app V s =
      restrictDivisorModulesAppOfCoeffAtEqOn K D E W hW V s := rfl

/-- Multiplication by the reciprocal of the generating section identifies the
restricted native section map with the zero-divisor comparison. -/
theorem restrict_homFromUnit_comp_principalization {D : X.CurveDivisor}
    (φ : Modules.Hom (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) (divisorModules K D))
    (q : X.functionFieldˣ)
    (hq : (q : X.functionField) * divisorVal K (φ.app ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))) = 1)
    (W : X.Opens)
    (hW : ∀ (z : X) (hz : z ≠ genericPoint X), z ∈ W →
      coeffAt hz (D - divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q) = coeffAt hz 0) :
    (Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).map φ ≫
      (Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).map (mulEquivDivisorModules K q D).hom ≫
      restrictDivisorModulesHomOfCoeffAtEqOn K
        (D - divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q) 0 W hW =
      (Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).map (moduleToDivisorModulesZero K) := by
  apply Modules.hom_ext
  intro V
  simp only [Modules.Hom.comp_app, restrict_map_app]
  ext r
  change (restrictDivisorModulesHomOfCoeffAtEqOn K
      (D - divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q) 0 W hW).app V
        ((mulEquivDivisorModules K q D).hom.app (W.ι ''ᵁ V) (φ.app (W.ι ''ᵁ V) r)) =
    (moduleToDivisorModulesZero K).app (W.ι ''ᵁ V) r
  rw [restrict_coeff_hom_app, moduleToDivisorModulesZero_app_apply]
  exact restrictDivisorModulesApp_principalization_homFromUnit K φ q hq W hW V r

/-- If the reciprocal of a section principalizes the divisor on an open, its
actual section map is invertible on that open. -/
theorem isIso_restrict_homFromUnit_of_principalization {D : X.CurveDivisor}
    (φ : Modules.Hom (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) (divisorModules K D))
    (q : X.functionFieldˣ)
    (hq : (q : X.functionField) * divisorVal K (φ.app ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))) = 1)
    (W : X.Opens)
    (hW : ∀ (z : X) (hz : z ≠ genericPoint X), z ∈ W →
      coeffAt hz (D - divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q) = coeffAt hz 0) :
    IsIso ((Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).map φ) := by
  let R := Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι
  let e : R.obj (divisorModules K D) ≅ R.obj (divisorModules K 0) :=
    R.mapIso (mulEquivDivisorModules K q D) ≪≫
      restrictDivisorModulesIsoOfCoeffAtEqOn K
        (D - divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q) 0 W hW
  have he : R.map φ ≫ e.hom = R.map (moduleToDivisorModulesZero K) := by
    change R.map φ ≫ R.map (mulEquivDivisorModules K q D).hom ≫
      (restrictDivisorModulesIsoOfCoeffAtEqOn K
        (D - divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q) 0 W hW).hom = _
    rw [restrict_coeff_iso_hom]
    exact restrict_homFromUnit_comp_principalization K φ q hq W hW
  haveI : @IsIso X.Modules _ _ _ (moduleToDivisorModulesZero K (X := X)) :=
    (divisorModulesZeroIso K (X := X)).isIso_inv
  haveI : IsIso (R.map φ ≫ e.hom) := by
    rw [he]
    infer_instance
  exact (isIso_comp_right_iff (R.map φ) e.hom).mp inferInstance

/-- A nonzero divisor section attaining its valuation bound is a native local
generator. At the generic point the valuation condition is empty. -/
theorem exists_affineOpen_isIso_restrict_homFromUnit {D : X.CurveDivisor}
    (φ : Modules.Hom (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) (divisorModules K D))
    (hs0 : divisorVal K (φ.app ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))) ≠ 0) (x : X)
    (hx : ∀ hx : x ≠ genericPoint X,
      ord (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx (divisorVal K (φ.app ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤)))) =
        divisorBound D hx) :
    ∃ W : X.Opens, x ∈ W ∧ IsAffineOpen W ∧
      IsIso ((Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).map φ) := by
  let w : X.functionFieldˣ := Units.mk0 (divisorVal K (φ.app ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤)))) hs0
  have hdiv : divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) w⁻¹ =
      - divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) w := by
    apply eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero.mpr
    rw [← divOf_mul (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)), inv_mul_cancel,
      divOf_one (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  have hcoeff : ∀ hx' : x ≠ genericPoint X,
      coeffAt hx' D = coeffAt hx' (divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) w⁻¹) := by
    intro hx'
    rw [hdiv]
    have hb : divisorBound (-divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) w) hx' =
        divisorBound D hx' := (ord_val_eq K w hx').symm.trans (hx hx')
    rw [divisorBound_eq_coeffAt, divisorBound_eq_coeffAt] at hb
    exact (congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd (WithZero.exp_injective hb)).symm
  obtain ⟨W, hxW, hW, hcoeffW⟩ := exists_affineOpen_coeffAt_eq K
    D (divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) w⁻¹) x hcoeff
  refine ⟨W, hxW, hW,
    isIso_restrict_homFromUnit_of_principalization K φ w⁻¹ ?_ W ?_⟩
  · change (divisorVal K (φ.app ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))))⁻¹ *
      divisorVal K (φ.app ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))) = 1
    exact inv_mul_cancel₀ hs0
  · intro z hz hzW
    rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_sub, hcoeffW z hz hzW,
      CurveDivisor.coeffAt_zero, sub_self]

/-- Exact valuation at a closed point makes the section map invertible on an
affine neighborhood; nonvanishing is a consequence of that exact valuation. -/
theorem exists_affineOpen_isIso_restrict_homFromUnit_of_ord_eq {D : X.CurveDivisor}
    (φ : Modules.Hom (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) (divisorModules K D))
    {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X)
    (hφ : ord (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx
      (divisorVal K (φ.app ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤)))) =
      divisorBound D hx) :
    ∃ W : X.Opens, x ∈ W ∧ IsAffineOpen W ∧
      IsIso ((Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).map φ) := by
  have hs0 : divisorVal K (φ.app ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hs0
    rw [hs0, map_zero] at hφ
    exact WithZero.coe_ne_zero hφ.symm
  exact exists_affineOpen_isIso_restrict_homFromUnit K φ hs0 x (fun _ => hφ)

omit [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] in
include K in
/-- A smooth integral curve has a point besides its generic point. The proof
uses a transcendental coordinate on a relative-dimension-one smooth chart. -/
theorem exists_ne_genericPoint_of_smoothCurve : ∃ z : X, z ≠ genericPoint X := by
  let f := X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)
  obtain ⟨U, hU, V, hV, hxV, e, hsm⟩ :=
    SmoothOfRelativeDimension.exists_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension
      (n := 1) (f := f) (genericPoint X)
  have hUtop : U = ⊤ := by
    have hsub : Subsingleton (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (PrimeSpectrum K))
    refine TopologicalSpace.Opens.ext (Set.eq_univ_of_forall fun y => ?_)
    exact Subsingleton.elim (f.base (genericPoint X)) y ▸ e hxV
  subst hUtop
  letI : Field Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of K), ⊤) :=
    ((ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.toMulEquiv.isField
      (Field.toIsField K)).toField
  haveI : Nonempty V := ⟨⟨genericPoint X, hxV⟩⟩
  letI : (f.appLE ⊤ V e).hom.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 := hsm
  algebraize [(f.appLE ⊤ V e).hom]
  letI : Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
      Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of K), ⊤) Γ(X, V) := hsm.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra.IsStandardSmooth Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of K), ⊤) Γ(X, V) :=
    Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.isStandardSmooth 1
  have hnf : ¬ IsField Γ(X, V) := by
    intro hfield
    letI : Field Γ(X, V) := hfield.toField
    letI : Module.Finite Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of K), ⊤) Γ(X, V) :=
      finite_of_finite_type_of_isJacobsonRing
        Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of K), ⊤) Γ(X, V)
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ :=
      Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.exists_transcendental
        Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of K), ⊤) Γ(X, V)
    exact ht (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic t)
  obtain ⟨p, hp0, hp⟩ := Ring.not_isField_iff_exists_prime.mp hnf
  let q : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, V) := ⟨p, hp⟩
  refine ⟨hV.fromSpec.base q, ?_⟩
  intro hq
  apply hp0
  have hqgen : q = genericPoint (Spec Γ(X, V)) := by
    apply hV.fromSpec.isOpenEmbedding.injective
    rw [genericPoint_eq_of_isOpenImmersion hV.fromSpec]
    exact hq
  have hqbot : p = (⊥ : Ideal Γ(X, V)) := by
    have := congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hqgen
    simpa [q, genericPoint_eq_bot_of_affine] using this
  exact hqbot

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
